name: Resample cortexmap data to a standard mesh using Connectome Workbench - fsaverage
summary: Resamples the surfaces, measures and labels of an fsaverage-space cortexmap to the standard fs_LR 32k or 164k mesh with Connectome Workbench, for group averaging of surface maps.
description: Uses the sphere.reg of a bundled fsaverage subject (chosen with the fsaverage parameter) and the fs_LR-deformed-to-fsaverage standard spheres to resample every surface, metric and label file of the cortexmap. Use it for cortexmaps produced on an fsaverage surface (e.g. by the fsaverage endpoint-mapping App); it needs no subject FreeSurfer input. The fsaverage choice must match the mesh the cortexmap was built on.

inputs.description: cortexmap built on an fsaverage surface (tag fsaverage); must include lh/rh.midthickness.fsaverage.surf.gii.

outputs.description: cortexmap with all surfaces, metrics and labels resampled to the chosen fs_LR standard mesh (tagged with the mesh size).

parameters.description: Standard fs_LR mesh density to resample to: 164k or 32k vertices per hemisphere.
Which bundled fsaverage subject (fsaverage to fsaverage6) the input cortexmap was built on; its sphere.reg is used for resampling.

citations.text: Fukutomi H, et al. Neurite imaging reveals microstructural variations in human cerebral cortical gray matter. NeuroImage (2018).

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check derivatives and logs
failure_modes.cause: The last func file was not written to the resampled cortexmap.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the fsaverage parameter matches the mesh of the input cortexmap.
